shared_blocks.scene_type: Editorial magazine-style product teaser, minimalist still-life cinematography, rollout teaser for product launch
shared_blocks.lighting: Soft, diffused studio daylight from a single directional source, casting a long, crisp-edged shadow of the column across the wall — the shadow itself becomes the primary visual subject at certain points, more legible than the object casting it. Cool-neutral grey tones throughout, no warm cast anywhere — any edge light stays cool white, never amber.
shared_blocks.composition: Extreme negative space — the object occupies no more than 15-20% of frame at any time, off-center, editorial-style asymmetric framing. Wide static holds interrupted by slow creeping push-ins that stop short of clarity. Frame breathes with empty wall space, evoking a magazine spread's white space.
shared_blocks.mood: Quiet anticipation, restrained tension, architectural minimalism, the sense of something about to be unveiled but withheld. Pace is unhurried — closer to a fashion editorial than a product ad.
shared_blocks.motion_detail: The column's shadow slowly lengthens as if light itself is moving in real time (implying time-lapse without stating it). A faint, almost imperceptible vibration or shimmer along the object's edge suggests material quality without showing texture detail.
shared_blocks.color_palette: Desaturated cool greys, soft off-white, charcoal shadow — matte, non-reflective surfaces only.
shared_blocks.negative: people, human hands, human figures, faces, text, typography, logo, watermark, subtitles, captions, sharp focus on product details, screws, cables, ports, brand marking, full frontal clear product shot, bright even lighting, cluttered background, furniture, interior decor, warm tone, amber cast, orange highlight

camera_variants.hf_050143: Slow, deliberate vertical drift, gliding up along the column's line without ever reaching its top or base. Camera holds at a low, oblique angle.
camera_variants.hf_051948: Slow, deliberate macro-to-wide dolly movement. Camera glides at a low, oblique angle along the vertical line of the object.
camera_variants.hf_021529: Slow, deliberate macro-to-wide dolly movement, gliding low across the floor plane. Camera never rises to reveal the column.
camera_variants.hf_054526: Slow, deliberate wide static hold with a barely-perceptible creeping push-in. Foreground wall sharp, background column soft.

palette_words.white_balance: cool-neutral, no warm or amber cast
palette_words.intro_only: warm cream glow #FFDFB3 + red ambient #FF4746 (20%) in highlights, one black-and-white cut
